title: AURA: Auditory Spatial Intelligence via a Unified Representation from a General-Audio Encoder through Complete Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.13687v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Answering spatial questions about multi-source scenes requires a model both to identify each sound and to locate it. Existing spatial audio-language models obtain spatial information from a dedicated encoder, which separates spatial and semantic processing into distinct feature spaces. We study whether a general-audio codec trained without spatial supervision can serve both purposes. A controlled layer-wise analysis shows that the frozen codec retains spatial information, with lateral cues carried by the difference between the two ear channels. This information, however, is not readily accessible: in dual-source scenes, a model trained on these features predicts left/right at chance and, on the remaining axes, assigns the detected direction to the queried and the non-queried source equally often. translated_title: AURA：通过完全对齐从通用音频编码器的统一表示实现听觉空间智能
translated_abstract: 回答关于多声源场景的空间问题，要求模型既能识别每个声音，又能对其进行定位。现有的空间音频-语言模型通过专用编码器获取空间信息，这将空间处理与语义处理分割到了不同的特征空间中。我们研究了在没有空间监督的情况下训练的通用音频编解码器能否同时实现这两种功能。受控的逐层分析表明，冻结的编解码器保留了空间信息，其中左右方位线索由两个耳道信号之间的差异所携带。然而，这些信息并不容易被直接利用：在双声源场景中，基于这些特征训练的模型对左右方向的预测仅处于随机水平，并且在其余空间轴上，模型将检测到的方向分配给被询问声源与未被询问声源的频率相同。我们将这种失败归因于音频-文本之间的信息不对称，即音频中包含两个声源，而答案仅描述了其中…（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AURA，证明未经空间监督训练的通用音频编码器本身通过双耳通道差异保留了空间信息，并通过完全对齐构建统一表示，克服音频-文本信息不对称问题，使单一编码器在多声源场景中同时实现声音识别与空间定位。
en_tdlr: AURA shows that a general-audio encoder trained without spatial supervision inherently retains spatial information carried by inter-ear channel differences, and through complete alignment builds a unified representation that overcomes audio-text information asymmetry, enabling a single encoder to achieve both sound identification and spatial localization in multi-source scenes.
